name: jurassic-modernization-agent
description: Modernization Intelligence Layer - 2-agent system for legacy codebase analysis and modernization

jurassic-planning.description: Planning Agent MCP server - read-only analysis of legacy codebases

jurassic-implementation.description: Implementation Agent MCP server - executes approved modernization plans

planning.name: repo_snapshot
planning.description: Fork-aware file indexing with language detection and file metadata

planning.name: fw_include_graph
planning.description: Build C/C++ include dependency graph with Tarjan SCC cycle detection

planning.name: py_import_graph
planning.description: Build Python import dependency graph with external package tracking

planning.name: gui_import_graph
planning.description: Build JavaScript/Vue import graph with component detection

planning.name: git_churn
planning.description: Analyze git history for file change frequency and hotspots

planning.name: complexity_metrics
planning.description: Calculate code complexity metrics per file

planning.name: risk_scoring
planning.description: Score risk per file based on churn, complexity, and safety factors

planning.name: safety_path_analysis
planning.description: Identify safety-critical code paths and execution zones

planning.name: stack_fingerprint
planning.description: Identify technology stack: languages, frameworks, build tools

planning.name: doc_coverage_analysis
planning.description: Analyze documentation coverage and identify gaps

planning.name: plan_synthesis
planning.description: Synthesize phased modernization plan from analysis artifacts

planning.name: user_dialog
planning.description: Interactive Q&A to capture user decisions mid-analysis

planning.name: policy
planning.description: Enforce governance, safety, and compliance policies

implementation.name: code_refactor
implementation.description: Apply language-aware code transformations (rename, extract, replace)

implementation.name: migration_executor
implementation.description: Execute migration phases from approved modernization plan

implementation.name: migration_evaluator
implementation.description: Evaluate migration feasibility with multi-dimensional scoring

implementation.name: dependency_upgrader
implementation.description: Upgrade npm/pip dependencies with version pinning

implementation.name: test_writer
implementation.description: Generate test code for vitest, pytest, or C assert frameworks

implementation.name: test_scaffold
implementation.description: Identify testable entry points and generate starter templates

implementation.name: pr_writer
implementation.description: Generate PR descriptions and create pull requests via GitHub API

implementation.name: incremental_pr
implementation.description: Create focused PRs for each migration task on user's fork

implementation.name: doc_ingest
implementation.description: Ingest PDF/documents via Azure Document Intelligence

implementation.name: report_generator
implementation.description: Generate HTML visualizations for dependency graphs and risk heatmaps

artifacts.description: Schema-validated JSON artifacts produced by agents

analyze_legacy_repo.description: Analyze a legacy repository and produce modernization intelligence

arguments.name: fork_owner
arguments.description: GitHub username that owns the fork

arguments.name: repo_name
arguments.description: Name of the repository to analyze

execute_modernization_plan.description: Execute an approved modernization plan with incremental PRs

arguments.name: run_id
arguments.description: ID of the planning run with approved artifacts
